acceptance: HTTP support is optional and disabled by default; enabling the feature adds one pinned Rustls-based client dependency and does not affect local path package commands.

The client constructs URLs only from a validated PackageSource::GitHub, performs public GET requests without Authorization or credentials, rejects redirects and unexpected hosts, sets a timeout and a bounded response size, and returns typed transport/status errors.

A local cache writes only beneath an explicitly supplied cache root, derives paths from validated repository/revision/subpath data, writes atomically, verifies cached manifest/entry bytes against the package digest, and fails closed on corruption or traversal.

An explicit CLI package fetch command accepts a repository slug, exact commit revision, optional subpath, cache directory and output directory; it never runs lifecycle code and never fetches private/authenticated content.
The fetched manifest and entry are parsed through aipo-package before output; source provenance, revision and digest remain visible in the resulting package and lock data.

Tests use a fake HTTP transport/cache fixtures for success, timeout/status/oversize/redirect/host rejection, cache hit, corruption, traversal, atomic write and no-network default behavior; no test contacts GitHub.
Security and user documentation define cache ownership, retention, public-only policy, resource limits and the explicit command required to enable network access; repository gates remain green.

amendments.reason: Lock the opt-in read-only GitHub HTTP/cache slice

evidence.description: aipo-package with the http feature passed 39 tests, including fake-transport success, redirect/status/timeout/oversize rejection, bounded response enforcement, cache round-trip, digest corruption and symlink/path safety.
aipo-cli with github-http passed 15 package integration tests, including explicit fetch argument validation; default package tests remain network-free.

cargo test --workspace --all-targets and cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features both passed; the default dependency tree contains no ureq, while the opt-in feature contains pinned ureq 3.4.2 with Rustls.
cargo deny check advisories bans licenses sources and cargo audit both passed with the new optional dependency graph.

cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo doc --workspace --no-deps, cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --all-features, node crates/aipo-js/runtime/selftest.mjs, prumo validate . and prumo doctor . all passed.

docs/reference/cli.md, docs/security/github-package-fetch.md, docs/security/security-contract.md, docs/diagnostics/catalog.md and docs/adp/ADP-007-package-identity-and-distribution.md record the public-only policy, cache ownership, limits, diagnostic and explicit feature boundary.
